candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout and 502, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show the timeout at the redis span, but no redis-side metrics/logs confirm whether the cause is redis saturation, network, or config.

report.explanation: Traces across multiple correlation IDs consistently show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating up through inventory (503), order (ReadTimeout/502), and gateway checkout (502). Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms, matching the ~2s timeouts. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout.
